name: gui95
description: Build or restyle Windows 95-inspired web and Electron interfaces with classic controls, menus, dialogs, crisp bevels, and keyboard behavior. GUI95 is a vibe-coded skill and reference collection by Stephen Lavelle.

interface.longDescription:
Build and restyle Windows 95-inspired web and Electron interfaces with GUI95, a vibe-coded skill and widget reference collection by Stephen Lavelle.

Create classic gray buttons, beveled panels, menus, dialogs, property tabs, toolbars, lists, split panes, and desktop workspaces. Adapt HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SVG icons, and interaction patterns from preserved Vector95 and ProcGen FM examples to your project's framework. Guidance covers keyboard navigation, focus, disabled states, cancellation, typography, and display scaling.

Use GUI95 to build a settings dialog, restyle an Electron utility, or review a retro interface's appearance and behavior. The companion browser desktop shows the patterns in working Explorer, Paint, Display Properties, Media Player, and Help examples.

The reference files are bundled; neither source application needs to be installed. GUI95 supplies implementation guidance and examples, not a drop-in component library or an operating-system emulator. Generated changes still need testing in the target application. Original material is MIT licensed; bundled third-party fonts and theme material retain their own notices. Independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.
defaultPrompt: Build a Windows 95-style settings dialog with tabs, keyboard navigation, and Apply/Cancel behavior.
Restyle this Electron utility with classic gray controls, crisp bevels, and readable typography.
Review this retro interface's menus, focus states, disabled controls, and keyboard behavior.

publication.release_notes: Require running UI feedback reports and a final handoff, retaining resolved problems, failed approaches, verification evidence and reusable lessons. Include the maintained build kit, 38 standalone widget examples, desktop delivery helpers, and expanded integration guidance. Preserved reference snapshots are unchanged.
